title: Spring-Summer Capsule Wardrobe for Men: 10 Pieces, Endless Outfits
excerpt: Build a 10-piece spring-summer capsule wardrobe for men. Includes linen blazers, tailored shorts, chinos, linen shirts — plus a formula for creating 30+ outfits from minimal pieces.
content:
## The Philosophy of Warm-Weather Minimalism

A capsule wardrobe is about precision. When temperatures rise and layering becomes limited, every piece must earn its place through versatility, comfort, and fit. The rule is simple: each piece must pair with at least three others in the collection. This approach saves you money, reduces decision fatigue, and ensures you always look intentional.

## The Five Tops: Shirts and Knits for Every Occasion

Start with a white linen button-down shirt. Next, a light blue Oxford cloth button-down in a slim fit. Third, a navy knit polo shirt in pique cotton — the knit texture is more refined than a standard polo. Fourth, a cream or beige unstructured linen blazer — the single most versatile warm-weather jacket. Fifth, a lightweight merino wool crewneck sweater in heather grey — merino wicks moisture even in summer.

## The Three Bottoms: Trousers and Shorts

First, tailored chinos in light beige or stone at around 220 grams weight. Second, linen blend trousers in navy. Third, tailored shorts in olive or taupe with a 7 to 9 inch inseam. Choose fabrics with structure like cotton twill or seersucker.

## The Two Shoes: Footwear for Every Scenario

First, suede loafers in medium brown — dressy enough for the blazer and trousers, casual enough for shorts and a polo. Second, minimalist white leather sneakers with a clean, low-profile silhouette. With these two shoes, you can dress any outfit up or down.

## The Formula: How to Build 30 Outfits

Five tops times three bottoms equals fifteen outfit combinations. Each works with either shoe choice, giving you thirty distinct looks. Roll the linen shirt sleeves for a casual stance. Leave the Oxford shirt untucked over shorts. Wear the blazer over just the polo for dinner. The capsule packs into a carry-on suitcase yet leaves you dressed better than most people with full suitcases.

## Seasonal Transition: From March to September

In early spring, pair the merino sweater over the Oxford shirt with navy trousers and loafers. By June, switch to the linen blazer over the polo with chinos and sneakers. The key is that all ten pieces remain the same; only the combinations shift with temperature. For cool summer evenings, the blazer doubles as insulation. The capsule is designed to be lived in and worn with confidence.
